evals.prompt: Audit this UI for WCAG and heuristic issues. The screen shows a data table with 8 columns. Column headers are light grey text on a white background. There are no row hover states. Error messages appear only as a red border on invalid form fields with no text explanation. The delete button triggers immediately with no confirmation dialog.
evals.expected_output: A severity-ranked findings list mapping each issue to a specific WCAG criterion or Nielsen heuristic, followed by a prioritized action list.
assertions: Reports the grey-on-white column headers as a contrast failure and cites WCAG 1.4.3
Flags the missing error text as a WCAG 1.4.1 violation (color as sole differentiator) and maps it to Heuristic 9
Flags the immediate delete action as a Heuristic 5 violation (error prevention) and recommends a confirmation dialog
Assigns severity levels (Critical, High, Medium, or Low) to each finding
Closes with a prioritized action list

evals.prompt: Build the page header for an Enverus One asset detail page titled 'Bakken Basin Acreage Blocks' with the subtitle 'Spatial · Enverus DI · Updated Sep 1 · Enverus'. The user arrived from the Library and needs a way to go back. Include a secondary 'Share' action and a primary 'Add to project' action.
evals.expected_output: A page header using the standard Enverus One structure, with the optional back button shown because this is a secondary page.
assertions: Wraps the header in an outer container with id="page-header" and classes flex flex-col flex-shrink-0 overflow-hidden, whose children are the optional back-button row and the page-titles row
Renders the back button in its own div id="back-button" (flex-shrink-0 px-6 pt-4) above the #page-titles row, not inside #page-actions
Back button uses the outline variant at small size (h-8) with a leading chevron-left icon and the label 'Back to Library'
Renders the title row as id="page-titles" with classes flex-shrink-0 px-6 py-4 flex items-start justify-between
Renders the title as a single h1 (text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground) inside a div id="page-title" with classes flex items-center gap-2
Renders the subtitle as a p id="page-subtitle" with classes text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5, directly below the title

Groups the actions in a div id="page-actions" with classes flex items-center gap-2 ml-4 flex-shrink-0, right-aligned inside #page-titles, with the secondary action (Share) before (left of) the single primary action (Add to project)

Supports light and dark themes: all colours come from semantic tokens defined for both :root and .dark-theme, with no hardcoded colours, so it renders correctly when .dark-theme is toggled on the root

Sets font-size: 14px on the html element (not body or a wrapper) and re-bases Tailwind's scale in px in the global CSS (--spacing: 4px, px --text-* sizes, --radius: 10px), so e.g. h-9 renders at 36px and text-sm at 14px
Sets color-scheme with the theme in the global CSS (color-scheme: light on :root and color-scheme: dark on .dark-theme, on the html element, not body), so scrollbars are not white in dark mode

evals.prompt: I'm building an Enverus One toolbar in React with four icon buttons: Search, Settings, Share and Delete. Which icons should I use and how should I import them?
evals.expected_output: Guidance that Enverus One uses the Lucide icon library, with Lucide icon imports from lucide-react and accessible icon-only buttons.
assertions: States that Enverus One uses the Lucide icon library
Imports the icons from lucide-react rather than another icon set (e.g. Tabler, Heroicons, Font Awesome)
Maps the four actions to matching Lucide icons (e.g. Search, Settings, Share or Share2, Trash2 or Trash)
Does not hand-draw or inline custom SVGs for these UI icons
Gives each icon-only button an aria-label
Does not add sizing classes (e.g. size-4) to icons inside shadcn components such as Button
Does not use the data-icon attribute on icons and does not set width/height, 1em or stroke-width on them, because Enverus One's Button sizes icons itself

evals.prompt: Build an Enverus One list page that shows a list of 'Spaces' in React. Each space also needs its own actions menu.
